title: BrewLimiter
description: BrewLimiter is a lightweight Minecraft server plugin that lets administrators control how much brewing power Blaze Powder provides.
body:
# BrewLimiter

BrewLimiter lets you change how much fuel a single Blaze Powder gives in brewing stands.

By default, Minecraft gives 20 brewing operations per Blaze Powder. With BrewLimiter, you can lower that value anywhere from 20 down to 0, making potions easier to balance on survival, economy, SMP, and progression-based servers.


## Features

- Set Blaze Powder brewing fuel from `0` to `20`
- Change the value in-game with `/brewlimiter set <0-20>`
- Reload config without restarting
- Works with Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, and Purpur
- Supports Minecraft `1.16.x` and newer, including `26.1`
- No complicated setup

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/brewlimiter` | Shows the current setting |
| `/brewlimiter get` | Shows the current setting |
| `/brewlimiter set <0-20>` | Sets the Blaze Powder fuel value |
| `/brewlimiter reload` | Reloads the config |
| `/brewlimiter reset` | Restores vanilla fuel power |

## Permission

```text
brewlimiter.admin
```

## Config

```yaml
fuel-power: 8
enabled: true
```

Set `fuel-power` to `20` for vanilla behavior, or `0` if you want Blaze Powder to stop being accepted as brewing fuel.
